Fig. 1 | Structural analysis and potential biosynthetic gene clusters of negamycin. a, The structural features of leucylnegamycin and negamycin suggest potential 
biosynthetic precursors. b, A gene cluster in S. purpeofuscus encoding Spb-like enzymes is not linked to HAA production. c, Two putative LAM genes are present in the 
genome of the negamycin producer S. purpeofuscus.
